Dear {!Account.Name},
Thank you for your interest in our Modon project. To proceed with your property purchase, please complete the mandatory Know Your Customer (KYC) process.
This is required by regulations and helps us support you throughout your property purchase. The KYC process is fully encrypted, secure, and typically takes no more than 5 minutes to complete.
Please have the following documents available:
UAE Residents:
• Passport copy
• Emirates ID
International Customers:
• Passport copy
Please click the button below to begin the KYC process:
Complete KYC
If you have any questions or need further assistance, please feel free to contact us on or call us on 800 MODON (800 66366) or email customercare@modon.com
Best regards,
Modon
